papers.title: TinyCast: Probabilistic Zero-Shot Forecasting with Computed Periodicity
papers.what: A 146,505-parameter attention-free zero-shot forecaster that computes the dominant periods of a context with a zero-parameter spectral detector instead of learning them, emitting a full predictive distribution and running end to end on a Cortex-M7 in 4.08 s within 731 KB of RAM.

papers.title: Listening Forward: Next Patch Embedding Prediction Enables Scalable Audio Learners (NAPE)
papers.what: Pretrains audio encoders by having a causal Transformer predict the next log-mel patch embedding using causal masking and a stop-gradient as the only training signal, dropping the reconstruction decoder, acoustic tokenizer, teacher network and auxiliary losses that current audio SSL recipes all carry.

papers.title: Chain-of-Experience for Continual LLM Improvement
papers.what: Measures how much language models improve when allowed to accumulate experiential traces across repeated test-time attempts, reporting a 5.6% overall gain at 19% lower API cost across eight models on math, coding and knowledge tasks, with most of the gain arriving in the early iterations.
papers.builds_on: Chain-of-Thought (2023, HBLPTRMY); Memory Mechanisms Survey (2026, BDY3HUCV); LATS (2024, 77ERE7HA)

papers.title: The Embedder's Dilemma: LLMs Are Better, but at What Cost?
papers.what: A cost-controlled comparison of 10 LLMs against 26 embedding models on 37 tasks finds the paradigms tied in aggregate (77.6 vs 77.2) while the LLM costs up to 1,431x more per benchmark pass, supporting a division of labour where embedding models handle similarity, classification and clustering.
